sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Lowers the minimum Android version to Android 12.
Opens the selected Studio or Simple Mode workspace on launch.
Opens the app in doodle mode without showing the plan selection screen. Log in from the home screen to use a plan.
Removes the monthly drawing time limit. Unlocks saving and exporting in doodle mode and full-length timelapse export with an optional logo.

sources.label: Morphe patch to downgrade minimum CSP version to SDK 31 (Android 12)
sources.author: Clip Studio Paint Android 12
patch_list: Enables Clip Studio Paint 5.1.4 to run on Android 12 (API 31) by backporting API 33+ calls and fixing resource crashes.
Fixes AndroidManifest.xml and XML drawables for Android 12 compatibility.
